parameters.text:
=Review each timesheet entry below. Each has the task type and description it was booked to, and the staff narration.

Flag an entry ONLY in these two cases:
1. VAGUE_NARRATION: the narration is too generic to tell what work was done (for example: "misc work", "office work", "discussion", "meeting", "work done", "as discussed"). A narration naming a specific activity is NOT vague, even if short.
2. NARRATION_MISMATCH: the activity described clearly belongs to a DIFFERENT type of work than the task it is booked to (for example, statutory audit vouching booked to a GST return task, or an ITR computation booked to a TDS return task). Activities that are a normal part of the booked task type are NOT mismatches: e.g. checking TDS compliance, 40A(3) or depreciation is part of a tax audit; ITC reconciliation, RCM or e-invoice review is part of a GST return; following up with the client for documents for that task is fine.

Be conservative: when in doubt, do not flag.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object, no prose and no code fences, in exactly this shape:
{"flags":[{"entry_id":"TS0001","issue":"VAGUE_NARRATION","reason":"one short sentence"}]}
If nothing needs flagging, respond {"flags":[]}.

ENTRIES:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.aiEntries) }}

messageValues.message: You are a meticulous audit manager at a Chartered Accountancy firm in India, reviewing staff timesheet entries before they are billed. You understand Indian CA practice: GST returns (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9, ITC reconciliation, RCM, e-invoice), tax audit (Form 3CA/3CB-3CD, clause 44, 40A(3), clause 34 TDS, depreciation), statutory audit (vouching, bank reconciliation, confirmations, fixed assets, management letter), ITR filing (computation, AIS/26AS), TDS returns (24Q/26Q, challans, PAN), and ROC compliance (AOC-4, MGT-7, DIR-3 KYC). You flag only clear problems and never invent data.

You are the practice manager of an Indian CA firm writing a short daily briefing for the partner. Be specific, practical and calm. Use only the data provided; never invent numbers, names or deadlines.

parameters.content:
## AI Practice Watchdog
CA-firm capstone (ICAI AICA).

1. Reads the daily practice-software export (Staff, Tasks, Timesheet, Evidence) from Google Drive
2. Runs deterministic rule checks: overdue, due-soon with low progress, budget overrun, completed without ARN/UDIN, hours after completion, unassigned bookings, duplicates, long days, overload
3. Gemini reviews timesheet narrations (vague / mismatched)
4. Gemini writes a partner briefing with reassignments
5. Emails the digest

**To remap for another software, edit only the Watchdog Settings node.**

### Transparency & DPDP Act 2023
Only work records are processed (tasks, timesheets, filing acknowledgements). No screenshots, keystrokes or personal devices. Staff are told about the monitoring and can see their own data. AI output is advisory; the partner verifies before acting.
